_comment: STEP 1 of route-engine spec v2 Part 7 — contain write authority. This file is the single global kill switch for every script that can write to Jobber or OptimoRoute. It is enforced at the HTTP transport by lib/write-gate.mjs, not at the call-site, so a script cannot bypass it by adding a new mutation. Default is OFF and enabling is time-boxed: an enable that is never explicitly revoked expires on its own, so writes can never be left switched on by accident. Flip it with scripts/write-authority.mjs, never by hand-editing.

standingGrants.reason: The one sanctioned standing writer. Sets the standard 3-hour arrival window so customer texts show a window instead of an exact route ETA. Mutation pre-approved by Spencer 2026-07-20; spec v2 says it stays running through every phase. Narrow by construction: jobEdit only, nothing else this script attempts will pass.

_policy: HUMAN-DRIVEN BY DECISION (Spencer 2026-08-21): no automation writes on a timer until the pipeline is proven. standingGrants is deliberately a list of ONE. Do not add to it during reconciliation, cleanup, or because a cron is failing — a cron being blocked by this gate is the gate working. Only Spencer adds a standing grant, and only against the promotion bar in route-engine/rules/scheduling-rules.json (writeRules.authorityModel).
